69:t_1:8.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
[It is the name for a social unit in ancient society based on blood relationships and male and female spouses.]

69:t_1:9.en:
$$レド$$
[So they had a custom like that...]

69:t_1:10.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
[The civilization and cultural practices of the $$ガルガンティア船団$$ are unusual even compared with those of $c.]

69:t_1:11.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
[However, their fundamental social principles are shared. From their perspective, the $$人類銀河同盟$$ would be considered unusual.]

69:t_1:13.en:
$n
「What's wrong, $$レド$$? Is something worrying you?」

69:t_1:14.en:
$$ガロード$$
「Pull yourself together. I'm planning to leave things here in your hands once I'm gone.」

69:t_1:15.en:
$$レド$$
「$$ガロード$$... Are you leav-ing?」

69:t_1:16.en:
$$ガロード$$
「Yeah. Once the $$ダナン$$ and $$クォーター$$ are repaired, I'm planning to go with $c.」

69:t_1:17.en:
$$ガロード$$
「I couldn't take $$ティファ$$ on a long trip with just the $$ダブルエックス$$ and $$Ｇファルコン$$, but with battleships, it's no problem.」

69:t_1:21.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「Constructive suggestion. I recommend Ensign $$レド$$ explain his stress to these individuals and seek their advice on resolving it.」

69:t_1:22.en:
$$宗介$$
「A Pilot Support Enlightenment Interface seems to make a considerate partner.」

69:t_1:23.en:
$n
「Why don't you get a permanent communications link with $$アル$$, too?」

69:t_1:24.en:
$$宗介$$
「No, thank you. Instead of enlightening me, all that thing does is cause me stress.」

69:t_1:25.en:
$$ティファ$$
「...I think $$チェインバー#pilot$$ is right. If anything's troubling you, please tell us.」

69:t_1:26.en:
$$レド$$
「...I met $$エイミー$$'s lit-tle brother...」

69:t_1:27.en:
$$ガロード$$
「Her brother... You mean $$ベベル$$?」

69:t_1:28.en:
$$レド$$
「I heard... he has an ill-ness...」

69:t_1:29.en:
$$ガロード$$
「I don't know the details either, but apparently he's got a chest condition and can't get out much.」

69:t_1:30.en:
$$レド$$
「In the $$人類銀河同盟$$... people who can't fight are dis-posed of...」

69:t_1:33.en:
$n
「...They aren't allowed to live... Is that it...?」

69:t_1:35.en:
$$ガロード$$
「And you were okay with that?」

69:t_1:36.en:
$$レド$$
「...$$エイミー$$ asked me the same ques-tion.」

69:t_1:38.en:
$$レド$$
「I didn't un-der-stand... what the ques-tion meant...」

69:t_1:40.en:
$$ティファ$$
「But you felt something... And not being able to explain that feeling is making you anxious.」

69:t_1:42.en:
$$ガロード$$
「This is so frustrating! People have things to do besides fighting! That's why...」

69:t_1:45.en:
$$オルダム$$
「He comes from a distant star. Some of his ways of thinking are bound to differ from ours at their very roots.」

69:t_1:47.en:
$$ティファ$$
「He's Dr. $$オルダム$$, our physician.」

69:t_1:48.en:
$$レド$$
「$$ベベル$$ men-tioned you, too... He said you know more than anyone in this fleet...」

69:t_1:49.en:
$$オルダム$$
「It's good to meet you, $$レド$$. Thank you for protecting the fleet the other day.」

69:t_1:50.en:
$$レド$$
「I have ques-tions... $$チェインバー#pilot$$, trans-late for me.」

69:t_1:52.en:
$$オルダム$$
「Oh... So that's the voice of the machine that understands language. I've heard about it.」

69:t_1:53.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「I request your interpretation of this fleet's organization.」

69:t_1:54.en:
$$オルダム$$
「What do you mean by interpretation?」

69:t_1:55.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「...This fleet is inefficient. Its command structure and discipline are incomplete; residents act chaotically. Protecting the weak serves no clear purpose.」

69:t_1:56.en:
$$オルダム$$
「Hahaha, I see. So that's how it looks to a visitor from space.」

69:t_1:57.en:
$$オルダム$$
「Oh, forgive me. Your definition of efficiency is rather narrow.」

69:t_1:59.en:
$$オルダム$$
「I believe $$ベベル$$ prompted these questions. If so, you should talk with him some more.」

69:t_1:60.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「Will conversation with him yield any useful information?」

69:t_1:61.en:
$$オルダム$$
「Whether it's useful is for you to decide.」

69:t_1:67.en:
$$ベベル$$
「...So you met Dr. $$オルダム$$.」

69:t_1:69.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「We cannot understand organizational behavior aboard $$ガルガンティア$$.」

69:t_1:71.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「I ask why its administration is so inefficient and pointless.」

69:t_1:72.en:
$$ベベル$$
「The fleet isn't an organization. We're just people who've come together.」

69:t_1:73.en:
$$ベベル$$
「Sometimes we fight, and sometimes we help each other. That's just how we live.」

69:t_1:74.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「What purpose does that serve?」

69:t_1:75.en:
$$ベベル$$
「If everyone can live with peace of mind, isn't that enough?」

69:t_1:76.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「...In the $$人類銀河同盟$$, a person like you would be culled immediately.」

69:t_1:77.en:
$$ベベル$$
「Someone like me wouldn't be much use in the fight against the $$ヒディアーズ#keyword$$...」

69:t_1:78.en:
$$ベベル$$
「But in that case, what will happen to the Alliance once all the $$ヒディアーズ#keyword$$ are defeated? What will you do, $$レド$$?」

69:t_1:79.en:
$$レド$$
「I will stand by un-til my next orders.」

69:t_1:80.en:
$$ベベル$$
「And if your next orders never come?」

69:t_1:84.en:
$$ベベル$$
「After all, standing by means... staying alive, right?」
